entries.2세 미만의 소아는 각각의 콧구멍에 1회씩 뿌립니다.2세 이상의 소아는: For children under 2 years of age, spray once into each nostril. For children 2 years of age and older, spray 1 to 2 times into each nostril, 2 to 4 times a day or whenever needed.
entries.스프레이 노즐은 1~24개월 영아에게, 젯 노즐은 6세 이상 어린이 및: Use the spray nozzle for infants aged 1 to 24 months and the jet nozzle for children 6 years of age and older and for adults, spraying 2 times into each nasal cavity in the morning and in the evening. To keep the solution from running down into the larynx or pharynx, lie on your side at an angle or stand with your head tilted while using it.
entries.심장질환, 고혈압, 갑상선질환, 당뇨병, 전립샘비대증으로 인한 배뇨곤란: Do not use this medicine if you have heart disease, high blood pressure, thyroid disease, diabetes, or difficulty urinating due to an enlarged prostate. Before using this medicine, women who are pregnant or who may be pregnant should consult a doctor or pharmacist. Follow the prescribed directions and dosage carefully. Do not use it in children. Use this medicine only in the rectum and do not use it orally. If the medicine has become soft, cool it briefly before use, and if it has become too hard, soften it before use. If your symptoms do not improve after about 7 days of use, stop using it immediately and consult a doctor or pharmacist.
entries.이 약 또는 벤잘코늄염화물에 과민증 환자는 이 약을 사용하지 마십시오.이: Do not use this medicine if you are hypersensitive to it or to benzalkonium chloride. Before using this medicine, consult a doctor or pharmacist if you have experienced allergic symptoms related to nasal drops (for example, rash, redness, swelling, or a stinging sensation), or if you have recently had nose surgery or have a lesion. Use this medicine only as a nasal drop. For hygiene, one product should be used by one person only. To keep the solution from running down into the larynx or pharynx, lie on your side at an angle or stand with your head tilted while using it.
This medicine is used for hemorrhoids.
entries.젯 노즐은 영유아가 사용 시 분사압력이 커서 잘못된 곳으로 들어가거나 후: The jet nozzle has a strong spray pressure, so when it is used in infants and young children there is a risk that the solution may enter the wrong place or that laryngeal spasm may occur.
Do not take this medicine together with antihypertensive medicines or antidepressants.
